FN-PFAHERR-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 94
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/08/2024
Senate Bill 94 as introduced would decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund
annually by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of gross receipts derived from
the sale of honey bees and their byproducts.

FN-PFAHERR-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 94
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/10/2024
Senate Bill 94 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would
decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund annually, for fiscal year 2025 through
fiscal year 2029 unless extended by the Legislature, by an undetermined amount dependent upon
the amount of gross receipts derived from the sale of honey bees and their byproducts.

FN-PFAHERR-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 94
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/30/2024
Senate Bill 94 as passed the Senate would decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust
Fund, for fiscal years 2025 through fiscal year 2029, by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the amount of gross receipts derived from the sale of honey bees and their inputs and
byproducts.
Page 1

FN-PFAHERR-4
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 94
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/01/2024
Senate Bill 94 as reported by the committee on Ways and Means Education would decrease
sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund for fiscal years 2025 through 2029 by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of gross receipts derived from the sale of
honey bees and their inputs and byproducts.
This bill would also decrease sales tax receipts to county and municipal funds for fiscal years
2025 through 2029 by an undetermined amount dependent on if the respective local
governments adopt an exemption from local sales and use tax, pursuant to this bill.
